neighbours.label: Digits of a converted quantity given in another unit, usually in a parenthesis ('850 hp (630 kW)', '486 km (302 mi)'); other numbers and parentheses stay quiet
fire: The 300 hp (224 kW) motor is very quiet.
The river runs 620 km (385 mi) to the sea.
The bridge spans 1,280 metres (4,200 feet) across the bay.
The reserve covers 900 acres / 364 hectares of marsh.
It weighs 20 tonnes (22 short tons) when loaded.
The tower is 120 ft (37 m) tall.
The lake is 30 miles (48 km) from the town.
quiet: The motor (built in 1998) is very quiet.
The river runs about 620 km to the sea.
The bridge spans the bay near the old town.
The reserve covers the marsh and 900 birds.
The lake is 30 miles from the town.
